rituals.name: Friendship Oath at Kissaten
performative_sequence: Unspoken pact of loyalty and transparency
rituals.significance: seals Kairi-Anna dyad; foundational to narrative

rituals.name: Winter Temple Visit — Ōmisoka / New Year
ritual_components: 108 bell chimes associated with the 108 bonnō (human desires/sufferings)
Amazake consumption (sweet rice sake, New Year tradition)
Matching amulets purchased as symbolic fusion
rituals.cultural_resonance: Buddhist-Shinto ritual environment at century threshold
rituals.significance: marks passage into new millennium; reinforces spiritual grounding

rituals.name: Daily Kissaten Kitchen Routine
ritual_elements: Apple pie and hot tea offering
Father's attentive listening to Kairi's words
Acceptance of Kairi's wildness without demanding conformity
rituals.perceptual_anchor_primary: taste (apple pie, tea) + smell (coffee) + touch (warm cup)
rituals.significance: primary emotional anchor; models unconditional care

rituals.name: Origami Lessons — Yuki-Kairi
practice_structure: Kairi struggles with dexterity and impatience
Yuki offers seated comfort: 'you can sit like me'
First successful objects: cat and dog, imperfect but celebrated
rituals.perceptual_anchor_primary: touch (hand guidance) + sight (paper folding) + emotional warmth
rituals.significance: establishes Yuki as surrogate mother; Japanese cultural transmission

rituals.name: Snow Igloo Construction — Winter Collective
rituals.setting: Field at Hirosaki margin, snow walls
components: Snowman construction with sticks for arms and nose
rituals.perceptual_anchor_primary: touch (cold snow, hand-contact) + sight (white dome) + sound (laughter, crunch)
rituals.significance: collective resilience; 'cento volte' thesis embodied (same ritual, different each year)

rituals.name: Mountain Pilgrimage Ascent
ritual_structure: Vista overlook: Hirosaki below, diminished in perspective
Paternal wisdom-fragment: 'bisogna prendere le cose alla giusta distanza' (must take things at proper distance)
rituals.perceptual_anchor_primary: sight (elevation gain, vista) + smell (mountain air) + silence + taste (tea)
rituals.significance: models wisdom through mountain presence; Iwaki as spiritual teacher
rituals.dissolution_marker: continues post-separation as Kairi's solitary practice

dissolution_rule: Ritual patterns persist after family dissolution through repetition, memory, or solitary practice; relational rituals may change participants while retaining their symbolic function. Atsuo-Kairi rituals survive intact post-separation; Atsuo-family rituals transform but don't vanish.
protocol_alignment: Perceptual anchors connect to narrative-perceptual-field.json; temporal markers align with narrative-system-graph.json cycles; significance bridges to narrative-scene.json canonical moments.
